title: Regression: Inventory tabs, toolbar and rows read correctly in dark mode with no tab indicator bar
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Theme set to Dark (profile > Dark); restore the previous theme after the test.
custom_steps:
1. Open /parts/inventory on the Active tab.
  2. Look at the Active and Inactive tab labels.
  3. Click the Inactive tab.
  4. Type QAPL in the search, open a filter chip, then open the ⋮ actions menu.
  5. Hover a few rows of the list.
custom_expected:
1. Title, tabs, toolbar and rows are dark-themed and every text reads correctly.
  2. The selected Active tab uses the primary colour and has no indicator bar under it; the Inactive label is readable.
  3. Inactive now uses the primary colour with no indicator bar; Active reads as unselected; the inactive rows (QAPL-I1…I3) are legible.
  4. The search field, the filter chip menu and the ⋮ menu items read correctly (no dark-on-dark or light-on-light text).
  5. Row hover shading keeps the row text legible.
